about: The owner's limits of 2026-11-24 for the places he noted or answered for, as given to scripts/draw-outline-rule.browser.js run(ids, {lightLanduse: ['industrial'], limits}). A limit is light ground the outline does not take ('poly' an area, 'lines' a road, 'near' a corridor it stays in, 'passWater' metres of water it may cross) or the owner's own area ('take'). Coordinates are [lon, lat] (WGS 84). Roads, points and the beach are read from the demo's basemap (OpenFreeMap 20261122_124456_pt, OpenMapTiles z14) and OpenStreetMap (ODbL).
status: geometry exact for มุกดาหาร, บ่อผุด (strip) and จอมเทียน; for the other limits it is still in the page's memory and is written here when it is exported (the browser extension disconnected at 18:20)
